simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גּוֹר (H1484) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גּוֹר (gôwr) means whelp. First listed occurrence: Jer 51 38.

definitions.full: H1484. gor [ גּוֺר ] noun [masculine] whelp (as quarrelsome? or onomatopoeia? perhaps = Assyrian giru Zehnpf BAS i. 504 ) of lion; — אֲרָיוֺת גּוֺרֵי Jer 51:38 (|| כְּפִרִים ) simile of Babylonians; compare גֹּרֹתָיו Nahum 2:13 (|| id. Nahum 2:14) figurative of Assyrians.
